inlines.v: HERED'ITARY, adjective 1. That has descended from an ancestor. He is in possession of a large hereditary estate. 2. That may descend from an ancestor to an heir; descendible to an heir at law. The crown of Great Britain is hereditary 3. That is or may be transmitted from a parent to a child; as hereditary pride; hereditary bravery; hereditary disease.
